profiles.title: Squat
profiles.cameraView: Side view; hip, knee and ankle visible
profiles.definition: Stand, lower, and return to standing.
profiles.limitation: Front-facing depth needs a separate calibrated rule.

profiles.title: Single-leg squat
profiles.cameraView: Side or diagonal view of working leg
profiles.definition: A complete lower-and-rise cycle for each leg.
profiles.limitation: Identify the working leg; never borrow the resting leg.

profiles.title: Lunge / split squat
profiles.cameraView: Diagonal view with both legs visible
profiles.definition: Lower and rise on the selected working side.
profiles.limitation: Count sides separately; distinguish steps from repetitions.

profiles.title: Lateral lunge
profiles.cameraView: Front view with both feet in frame
profiles.definition: Shift, bend the working knee, and return.
profiles.limitation: Needs a lateral-motion rule and per-side counts.

profiles.title: Step-up
profiles.cameraView: Side view including platform and both feet
profiles.definition: Step up fully, then return to the floor.
profiles.limitation: Platform occlusion and lead-leg identity need validation.

profiles.title: Hip hinge / deadlift
profiles.cameraView: Side view of shoulder, hip, knee and ankle
profiles.definition: Hinge down and return upright.
profiles.limitation: Knee angle alone is insufficient; load is entered manually.

profiles.title: Single-leg hinge
profiles.cameraView: Side view including supporting and free legs
profiles.definition: Hinge and return on one supporting leg.
profiles.limitation: Separate sides and balance corrections from complete reps.

profiles.title: Bridge / hip thrust
profiles.cameraView: Side view of shoulders, hips and knees
profiles.definition: Raise the hips and return to the starting position.
profiles.limitation: Bench, bar and floor occlusion require setup-specific validation.

profiles.title: Leg extension
profiles.cameraView: Side view with hip, knee and ankle exposed
profiles.definition: Extend the working knee and return.
profiles.limitation: Machine pads can hide the knee; count each working side.

profiles.title: Leg curl
profiles.cameraView: Side view with hip, knee and ankle exposed
profiles.definition: Bend the knee and return.
profiles.limitation: Seated, prone and standing positions need separate calibration.

profiles.title: Nordic / glute-ham raise
profiles.cameraView: Side view including knees and torso
profiles.definition: Lower the torso and return to the start.
profiles.limitation: Assistance and eccentric-only reps need explicit treatment.

profiles.title: Calf raise
profiles.cameraView: Side view including heels and toes
profiles.definition: Lift the heels and lower completely.
profiles.limitation: Requires foot landmarks and small-motion resolution beyond current joint data.

profiles.title: Elbow curl
profiles.cameraView: Side or diagonal view of shoulders, elbows and wrists
profiles.definition: Lower, curl, and lower each working arm.
profiles.limitation: Keep arm counts separate, including alternating curls.

profiles.title: Bench / horizontal press
profiles.cameraView: Side view of shoulders, elbows and wrists
profiles.definition: Extend, lower, and press to extension.
profiles.limitation: Rack and bench occlusion; independent arms need their own rule.

profiles.title: Push-up
profiles.cameraView: Side view including torso and arms
profiles.definition: Lower and press back up while maintaining the starting body position.
profiles.limitation: Distinguish setup, knee support and partial reps.

profiles.title: Overhead press
profiles.cameraView: Front-diagonal view with hands visible overhead
profiles.definition: Press from shoulders overhead and return.
profiles.limitation: Requires shoulder and wrist height as well as elbow angle.

profiles.title: Pike / landmine press
profiles.cameraView: Side view including torso and working arm
profiles.definition: Press along the intended inclined path and return.
profiles.limitation: Do not reuse horizontal-press thresholds without calibration.

profiles.title: Pull-up / pulldown
profiles.cameraView: Front-diagonal view with full arm path visible
profiles.definition: Pull through the prescribed range and return.
profiles.limitation: Hanging body motion and seated machines require different references.

profiles.title: Row
profiles.cameraView: Side-diagonal view of torso and working arms
profiles.definition: Pull toward the torso and return.
profiles.limitation: Torso motion and supported or unilateral variants need validation.

profiles.title: Dip
profiles.cameraView: Side view with shoulders and elbows clear
profiles.definition: Lower and press back to the starting support.
profiles.limitation: Bars and rings can hide joints; assistance cannot be inferred.

profiles.title: Triceps extension
profiles.cameraView: Side view of the working upper arm
profiles.definition: Bend and extend the elbow along the selected exercise path.
profiles.limitation: Overhead, prone and pushdown variants have different start poses.

profiles.title: Arm raise
profiles.cameraView: Front or side view aligned with the movement plane
profiles.definition: Raise the arm and lower to the start.
profiles.limitation: Front and lateral raises need different camera views and rules.

profiles.title: Fly / pull-apart
profiles.cameraView: Front-diagonal view with both hands visible
profiles.definition: Open and close the arms through the intended arc.
profiles.limitation: Pressing and elbow flexion must not become fly reps.

profiles.title: Straight-arm pull / pullover
profiles.cameraView: Side view of shoulder and wrist path
profiles.definition: Move the extended arm through its arc and return.
profiles.limitation: Needs torso-relative wrist motion, not an elbow-cycle counter.

profiles.title: Crunch / sit-up
profiles.cameraView: Side view including shoulders, hips and knees
profiles.definition: Curl the trunk and return.
profiles.limitation: Small crunches and full sit-ups need different range calibration.

profiles.title: Leg raise / reverse crunch
profiles.cameraView: Side view including torso and legs
profiles.definition: Raise and lower the legs through the prescribed range.
profiles.limitation: Different floor and hanging starts; distinguish swinging.

profiles.title: Hip abduction / adduction
profiles.cameraView: View facing the leg movement plane
profiles.definition: Move the working leg out or in and return.
profiles.limitation: Per-side identification and machine-pad visibility are required.

profiles.title: Quadruped extension
profiles.cameraView: Side-diagonal view of all supporting limbs
profiles.definition: Extend the selected limb or diagonal pair and return.
profiles.limitation: Count each side without counting weight shifts.

profiles.title: Dead bug
profiles.cameraView: Side-diagonal view of arms, hips and legs
profiles.definition: Extend a diagonal arm/leg pair and return.
profiles.limitation: Requires paired-limb tracking and explicit per-side counting.

profiles.title: Back extension
profiles.cameraView: Side view of shoulder, hip and knee
profiles.definition: Lower and raise the trunk or legs as prescribed.
profiles.limitation: Apparatus and floor variants need distinct references.

profiles.title: Trunk rotation
profiles.cameraView: Front-diagonal view of shoulders and hips
profiles.definition: Rotate and return for each side.
profiles.limitation: 2D overlap can hide rotation; requires 3D validation.

profiles.title: Rollout / pike
profiles.cameraView: Side view with hands and feet in frame
profiles.definition: Extend or fold the body and return to the start.
profiles.limitation: Needs multiple joint relationships, not a single angle.

profiles.title: Jumping jack
profiles.cameraView: Front view with hands and feet fully in frame
profiles.definition: Open arms and legs, then close.
profiles.limitation: Fast motion and frame coverage need validation.

profiles.title: Alternating knee drive
profiles.cameraView: Side-diagonal view including both knees
profiles.definition: Drive one knee and return, counted per side.
profiles.limitation: Distinguish running or plank starts and alternating steps.

profiles.title: Forearm plank
profiles.cameraView: Level side view with shoulder, elbow, wrist, hip, knee and ankle visible
profiles.definition: Accumulate observed time after a stable forearm-plank position.
profiles.limitation: Experimental posture recognition; cannot assess form, effort or floor contact.

profiles.title: Side plank
profiles.cameraView: View facing the chest with supporting arm and feet visible
profiles.definition: Time a stable side-support position for the selected side.
profiles.limitation: Needs support-side and body-orientation validation.

profiles.title: Wall sit
profiles.cameraView: Level side view with shoulder, hip, knee and ankle visible
profiles.definition: Time a stable seated hold with hips and knees bent.
profiles.limitation: Camera cannot verify wall contact; use an actual wall.

profiles.title: Hollow hold
profiles.cameraView: Level side view including shoulders, hips and feet
profiles.definition: Time the prescribed raised-shoulder and raised-leg position.
profiles.limitation: Floor contact and lower-back position cannot be verified from joints.

profiles.title: Dead hang
profiles.cameraView: Full body side-diagonal view including bar and wrists
profiles.definition: Time a stable overhead hanging position.
profiles.limitation: Joints alone cannot prove grip, foot clearance or load-bearing.

profiles.title: L-sit
profiles.cameraView: Side view including hands, hips, knees and ankles
profiles.definition: Time the supported upright torso with legs extended forward.
profiles.limitation: Requires support contact and foot clearance validation.

profiles.title: Handstand
profiles.cameraView: Side view with hands and feet fully in frame
profiles.definition: Time a stable inverted support position.
profiles.limitation: Inversion, wall support and safe entry need separate validation.

profiles.title: Lever hold
profiles.cameraView: Side view including support, torso and legs
profiles.definition: Time the selected horizontal or tucked lever position.
profiles.limitation: Front, back and tuck variants need distinct posture definitions.

profiles.title: Planche / crow support
profiles.cameraView: Side-diagonal view including hands and feet
profiles.definition: Time the selected supported balance position.
profiles.limitation: Contact, tuck and lean variants cannot share a generic plank detector.

profiles.title: Ring support
profiles.cameraView: Full body side-diagonal view including both rings
profiles.definition: Time a stable upright straight-arm support.
profiles.limitation: Cannot infer load-bearing or foot clearance from arm angles alone.

profiles.title: Gymnastic bridge hold
profiles.cameraView: Side view including hands, shoulders, hips and feet
profiles.definition: Time a stable raised bridge position.
profiles.limitation: Needs its own geometry and support validation; never infer form quality.

groups.reason: Use manual reps: ballistic or compound phases need equipment tracking and a dedicated sequence model.
Use manual reps: multiple phases, partial or one-way cycles, or changing support make a generic counter ambiguous.
Use manual reps: flight, landings and fast motion need dedicated validation.
Use manual reps or a manual timer: travel may leave a stationary camera's view.
Use the existing manual timer or equipment metrics; camera cycles do not establish duration, distance or effort.
Use manual reps: subtle or overlapping joint motion is not dependable with the current body landmarks.
Use manual reps or a manual timer: mobility endpoints and intended hold duration vary.
